pulse.text: **Quiet 12 hours** — no new frontier model and no leaderboard movement since Claude Sonnet 5 shipped Jun 30; **Claude Opus 4.8 still leads** the AA Index (v4.1) at **56**, ahead of GPT-5.5 (55), Sonnet 5 (53) and Gemini 3.1 Pro (46). The only fresh signal is the clock on two imminent releases: Polymarket's 'GPT-5.6 released on' market now pins a **modal ship date of ~July 7 (41%)** for the broad public rollout, with the by-July-31 window at **95%**, while Gemini 3.5 Pro's July GA holds at **94% by Jul 31** (still Vertex-only preview). The best-model-in-July race is unchanged — **Anthropic ~91%** on Polymarket, Google ~8%, OpenAI ~2%. Housekeeping: the tracker adds **Google's Gemini 3.5 Flash** (1M context, $1.50/$9, beats Gemini 3.1 Pro on agentic coding), a fast/cheap tier that had been missing. Worth watching next: whether GPT-5.6 actually opens to everyone this week — the likeliest near-term jolt to the standings.
